correctness.rationale: The finite Fourier mask factors exactly, and a factor vanishes iff the least different base digit is parity-opposite. Binary-tree saturation classifies every spectral partner and gives T. Period orders divide the partner cardinality; if 4|b the half-period is not a zero, whereas for b=2u with odd u the entire H_s minus zero is in the mask zero set. The H_s-invariant spectra are in bijection with full binary trees of depth n-s and independent H_s coset selections, proving F_s. Nested stabilizers and orbit-stabilizer/Burnside prove the exact strata and orbit formula. The derivation includes b=2 and n=1. Twelve explicitly generated small cases, eleven independent exhaustive subset censuses, and 194 exact cyclotomic comparisons passed; finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Finite b-adic Cantor approximants are canonical spectral sets, and frequency translation is a natural equivalence on their exponential bases. The nontrivial structural distinction between b divisible by 4 (every spectrum aperiodic) and b congruent 2 modulo 4 (stabilizers of every permissible power-of-two order for b>2, with a unique full-group-stabilized spectrum at b=2), together with precise counts of all orbit strata at every depth, solves a motivated symmetry-enumeration problem. Mere restatement of the known tree mechanism or an isolated finite count is not the valued claim.
